children: STOCKHOLM--Swedish fashion retailer Hennes & Mauritz is scheduled to report results for its fiscal third quarter on Thursday. Here is what you need to know:

NET PROFIT: H&M is expected to report net profit of 3.46 billion kronor ($351.6 million) for the June-August period, according to a FactSet poll. This compares with 3.21 billion kronor a year earlier.
SALES: Sales are expected to nudge 0.1% higher to 57.09 billion kronor, according to FactSet.
Shares have risen 9.5% over the past 12 months to around 166.75 kronor.
Pareto Securities analysts Kristian Smolle and Alexander Siljestrom expect muted organic sales growth of 0.8% in the quarter, with a soft German market, and a subdued U.K. and U.S. market.

Inderes analyst Lucas Mattsson believes that profitability should remain stable, although tailwinds that supported gross margins will fade and operating expenses increase. Mattsson looks for a gross margin of 53.5% from 52.9% a year ago.

Key focus for the upcoming report will be September sales and margin outlook, according to Mattsson. Due to the continued warm weather, Mattsson sees a risk that demand for autumn clothing will shift to the second half of the fourth quarter.

Pareto Securities expects the adjusted EBIT margin to remain flat on year at 8.7%, with adjusted EBIT growth at 1.4%. "We estimate a tariff refund of about SEK1 billion, however the impact should be limited considering it will be booked as an item affecting comparability."
